test_title: PYST 31: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 19 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

It was extremely difficult for me to __suppress__ my anger.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Release**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"suppress"** means to forcibly put an end to something or to restrain oneself from expressing feelings or emotions. (दबाना)

 
 
• **Example: **She tried to suppress her laughter during the serious meeting.
 
 
 
• **"Release" **refers to the act of letting go, allowing something to be free, or expressing emotions openly. (मुक्त करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He released his pent-up anger by yelling loudly.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'suppress'** is **'release'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Release**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Praise **(प्रशंसा): To express admiration or approval for someone or something.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher praised the student for his excellent performance in the exam.
 
 
 
• **Harass **(परेशान करना): To disturb or trouble someone persistently.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt harassed by the constant calls from unknown numbers.
 
 
 
• **Reward **(इनाम): A prize or recognition given for achieving something.
 
 
• **Example:** He received a reward for his hard work and dedication.
 
 

3f:T490,
The correct answer is option 4.</s
